name: Minato Miku
source:
Likes: strawberries, cakes, music
Dislikes: green tea, sports, home

Miku seems to be involved with Sayo. She likes cute clothes and is always quiet. She speaks with a Kyoto dialect, but she isn't from Kyoto.
She has family problems, so she usually goes to the live-music house to heal her mind through listening to music.

[Taken from [url=http://shizuku.aiueokompany.com/]Official Website[/url]]
